seed: Start from the transitions where an action produced no change at all. Find what blocked the action in each case and write the blocking condition before the movement rule.

synth.notes:
Ring (player) + beam (arm) + 4x4 blocks; A1/A2 move ring+beam by 6, carrying on-beam blocks and pushing blocks they hit.
Blocking: a move is cancelled when any block would leave the play rect (colour-4 field above the HUD bar row); A4 stops at max beam width.
A4/A3 change beam width by 6; a hooked next/collected block drags the on-beam blocks, otherwise extension pushes blocks in the swept columns.
HUD: row-53 bar fills one cell from the right every 3rd non-click action (count is hidden state, gated on continuity); a collected block's legend icon gets a 0 centre.
Open: the bar phase can't be recovered without continuity, and the order of tags after the whole level is collected was never observed.
